children: HeartSciences Inc. reported results for the quarter ended July 31, 2026 (Q1 2027 fiscal), posting revenue of $2.1K and a net loss of $(3.17M), or diluted EPS of $(0.86). Revenue was essentially flat year‑over‑year versus $1.9K, while the company’s loss widened from $(2.06M) in the year‑ago quarter.
Revenue was $2.1K for Q1 2027 (three months ended July 31, 2026), essentially flat versus $1.9K in the year‑ago quarter.
Net income: Net loss of $(3.172M) for the quarter ended July 31, 2026, versus net loss of $(2.055M) in the year‑ago quarter (widened loss YoY).
Diluted EPS was $(0.86) for the quarter ended July 31, 2026, versus $(1.58) in the year‑ago quarter.
Product and platform: MyoVista Insights™ launched in 2025; major v1.3 upgrades in 2026 added mobile access, reporting, interoperability and an AI marketplace.
AI marketplace and partnerships: Launched an AI‑ECG Algorithm Marketplace in June 2026 and integrated the first FDA‑cleared model from Bunkerhill Health for SaaS delivery.
Commercial traction: Signed the company’s first two commercial deployment agreements in May 2026, though material SaaS revenue has not yet been realized during the development stage.

Regulatory and device strategy: The wavECG device 510(k) was submitted in December 2025 and is under FDA review; the company has shifted primary focus toward its cloud platform rather than a proprietary device strategy.
Validation and IP: Achieved Epic Toolbox designation in March 2026 and was granted a European patent in June 2026, supporting platform credibility and market access.
